title: Flogo Data Pipeline Connection
description: A reusable data endpoint (database, stream, object store, HTTP). Secrets are NOT stored here — they live in VS Code Secret Storage and are referenced by secretKeys.

name.description: Display name bound on source/sink stages.

fields.description: Non-secret connection fields (host, port, database, bucket, …).

secretKeys.description: Field keys whose values are held in VS Code Secret Storage.
